title: Discount steakhouse chain closed over 600 restaurants, 15 left
summary: The definition of discount steakhouse has changed over the decades. From the 1950s through maybe the 1990s (although some old-school locations have lingered) low-priced steakhouses offered cheap steak, and usually an all-you-can-eat salad bar. The models varied slightly, but the focus was on value. ...
